title: [Bug]: Cannot run redpanda testcontainer with podman

Redpanda

### Testcontainers version

1.19.7

### Using the latest Testcontainers version?

Yes

### Host OS

Linux

### Host Arch

x86_64

```shell
Emulate Docker CLI using podman. Create /etc/containers/nodocker to quiet msg.
podman version 4.9.3
```

### Additional Information

I have not had a chance to try this with *actual* docker, but I have podman on my machine.  I can run the redpanda container on the command line, and it works perfectly well.  However, there is some issue when I try to run it as a test container with the modifications that the RedpandaContainer tries to make.  Let me know if I can try anything else to help debug this issue.  Thanks!
